title: Seireki 1999: Pharaoh no Fukkatsu
overview:
In 1999, the aliens came to Earth after all! The people of Earth are thrown into confusion as the aliens begin their invasion. And at last, the mystery of the pyramids is revealed!

Seireki 1999: Pharaoh no Fukkatsu is a first-person shooter set in and around the ancient Egyptian city of Karnak, brought back to life in 3D graphics. The sole survivor of a downed helicopter team, you are guided by the spirit of King Ramses against insect-like aliens and their mummies, Anubis soldiers, scorpions and evil spirits. Stages are linked by a map you can travel freely, and the weapons and ancient artifacts you find - granting powers such as higher jumps, levitation and breathing underwater - open up areas that were out of reach before.

- Hunt down eight hidden transmitter pieces
- Find every hidden doll to unlock the bonus multiplayer game Death Tank
- Memory backup save

1999年、やはりエイリアンが地球に襲来した！
侵略を始めるエイリアンに、とまどう地球人。
そして、遂に明かされるピラミッドの謎！
